b:
Before it touches the body
it touches the heart
and touches the soul

Like the bee that touches the flower,
it touches the mind
and touches the nectar
and makes you
forget everything

O tender young shoot
of humanity's richness,

in my withered heart
you sprouted; your
young buds
held me up….
I clung to them.

That clinging
is a plunder of joy,
and the joy…. a rain of honey
